result.stdout:
sif - AI agent for local OpenAI-compatible models

Usage: sif [--tools bash,edit,read,write,sleep,serve,context,roslyn] [--model 
name] [--base-url url]

  (no args)     Start an interactive chat session
  complete  Run a one-off prompt and exit
  config  Show or set configuration
  models  List, add, switch, or remove model profiles
  secure  Manage secure API key storage
  setup  Run the first-launch setup wizard
  update  Update sif.agent to the latest version
  vscode  Install, remove, or inspect the companion VS Code extension
  uninstall  Remove the global tool and VS Code extension

Options (all commands):
  -m, --model <name>     Model to use
  -p, --profile <name>   Use a named model profile
  -u, --base-url <url>   API base URL
  -k, --api-key <key>    API key
  -s, --system <text>    System prompt
  -t, --temperature <v>  Sampling temperature
  -max, --max-tokens <v> Max tokens to generate
  -n, --no-stream        Disable streaming output
  --tools <list>         Enable tools: 
bash,edit,read,write,sleep,serve,context,roslyn (comma-separated)
  --thinking <true|false> Enable model thinking/reasoning

Environment variables:
  AGENT_BASE_URL  - OpenAI-compatible API base URL
  AGENT_API_KEY   - API key (optional for local models)
  AGENT_MODEL     - Model name
  AGENT_TOOLS     - Comma-separated list of tools to enable
  AGENT_THINKING_ENABLED - Enable model thinking/reasoning
  AGENT_MAX_TOKENS - Max tokens to generate
  AGENT_TEMPERATURE - Sampling temperature
  AGENT_COMPACTION_THRESHOLD - Chat-history token threshold for compaction (0 
disables)
  AGENT_AUTO_UPDATE_ENABLED - Check for updates on startup
  AGENT_AUTO_UPDATE_SOURCE - Optional tool source for updates (defaults to 
nuget.org)
